name: Godrej Agrovet Ltd
title: Godrej Agrovet Ltd - 540743 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 volume-led growth with Crop Care guided to recover from Q2 FY27 after co-marketing inventory overhang; FY27 guide is early double-digit revenue and mid-teens PBT growth, with capex about INR350 crore and ~INR100-125 crore surplus.

capex.quote: our capex requirements would be in the coming years we have pretty much first of all out of our overall capex would be in the range of around 350-odd crores.

triggers.label: Crop Care co-marketing inventory clears by Q2
triggers.quote: the recovery of the Crop Care business would start -- we'd start seeing it coming back fully from quarter two onwards

triggers.label: Capex ~INR350-400 crore, 75-80% growth
triggers.quote: Roughly around 75% to 80% of that capex will be growth capex for us.

triggers.label: ROCE 16% → 20% on working capital
triggers.quote: our return on capital employed has also moved along with our results from 16% to now 20%

triggers.label: FY27 early double-digit revenue, mid-teens PBT
triggers.quote: we'd like to focus on getting an early double-digit revenue growth across put together at a consol level

triggers.label: Astec prices bottomed, Q4 volume and price up
triggers.quote: This is primarily because more or less the prices have bottomed out.

guidance.quote: we'd like to focus on getting an early double-digit revenue growth across put together at a consol level
we'd like to again target a let's say a mid-strong double-digit, mid-teens kind of a PBT growth also for the next year
We'd like to again go for a double -digit growth in revenue led by volume in Animal Nutrition business
So I think we should aim around 15% of growth in terms of the top line.

guidance.value: very high double-digit revenue and profit growth
guidance.quote: it will be again a very high double-digit numbers that will happen in the Crop Care business.
looking for another year of double -digit volume growth in oil palm, early double-digit.
which is close to INR400 crores, we should be left with around INR100 crores, INR125 crores kind of cash surplus
we'll keep the CDMO percentage going well in the range of around, you know, 52 % to 53% plus kind of salience
we would like this business to have roughly around 50 % to 55% of its portfolio over a period of maybe FY31

guidance.metric: Crop Care new product contribution FY27
guidance.value: 16-18% of business from two new products
guidance.quote: We expect these two products itself to contribute roughly around anywhere between 16% to 18% of our business.

red_flags.label: Astec governance and structure review unresolved
red_flags.quote: it is too premature for us to comment on the same, you know. We are in the process of evaluating

red_flags.label: Crop Care single-product dependence and co-marketing inventory
red_flags.quote: we have been very much stuck onto a what we call as a sing le point of failure.

red_flags.label: Monsoon / El Nino risk to FY27 guide
red_flags.quote: we would like to stay course on this guidance as of now and see how we can play it out

evasions.quote: it is too premature for us to comment on the same, you know.
this is something which is very difficult to comment because this is a larger decision
we are right now playing it quarter-to-quarter honestly
